meta.formulation: phase-domain current-voltage AC optimization; each inverter is a two-stage bidirectional equivalent circuit solved jointly with the network, minimising the selected norm of per-inverter curtailment subject to hard relative voltage limits, BMOPF from-side series-current ratings and inverter kVA limits

units_and_base.voltage_base: each bus uses its own nominal line-to-neutral voltage
units_and_base.power_units: W in reported quantities, per unit inside the model
